items.html: And afterward, in the Shema of Shaharit, then in the first verse of 'Shema Yisrael' AVI couple in a complete coupling. And afterward, in the second verse of Baruch Shem, Ima lowers power and bounty that goes out of her complete coupling, as mentioned, into the Nukva of ZA, so that there will be in her the power to raise the MAN of those Mochin, to bring out new souls in the coupling of the standing, as above. And this was already explained, that in the verse of Shema it is opposite Ima, and in Baruch Shem it is opposite Malchut.
